business_problem: Capital Bank needed a modern data hub that could unify data from core banking and acquired institutions so it could integrate new businesses quickly, personalize retail banking, and support fraud and risk analytics at scale.
solution_summary: Capital Bank modernized its data foundation with IBM Cloud Pak for Data and IBM Netezza Performance Server as the primary data warehouse. Jordan Business Systems used the platform to centralize data from core banking and more than 15 banking applications, then integrate data from acquired banks across Jordan and Iraq. Once the single source of truth was established, Capital Bank's developers and data scientists began using IBM Watson Machine Learning in Watson Studio on Cloud Pak for Data to predict customer behavior, score product propensity, identify churn risk, and look for suspicious transaction patterns tied to fraud and money laundering. The same data hub also underpins mobile-experience dashboards that help operational teams pinpoint issues quickly. This architecture ties together data integration, warehousing, analytics, and machine learning so the bank can move from acquisition-driven scale to hyper-personalized digital banking and faster operational response.

data_flow: Core-banking, HR, payroll, card, CRM, and acquired-bank data is centralized in Netezza through Cloud Pak for Data, then machine-learning models in Watson Studio and Watson Machine Learning analyze customer behavior, operational issues, and suspicious transactions for targeted offers and risk controls.
business_outcome: Capital Bank accelerated acquisition integration, improved customer-experience monitoring, and built the predictive-data foundation needed for hyper-personalized offers, churn prevention, and stronger financial-crime detection.
